Both tasks are implemented in `llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py` and verified.

**Task 1 — `get_image_mimetype()`** (types.py:90): lazy MIME type resolution with caching. Returns the stored `image_mimetype` if set; otherwise guesses via `filetype.guess` (only when image bytes exist) and caches the result. The inline guess logic was removed from `image_to_base64`, which now delegates to `self.get_image_mimetype()` (types.py:83).

**Task 2 — `encoding` field** (types.py:58): `Literal["base64", "raw"]`, default `"base64"` preserving existing behavior. `image_to_base64` skips base64 encoding when `encoding="raw"` (types.py:85), and `resolve_image` respects the field so raw blocks yield raw bytes (types.py:109-115) while base64 behavior is unchanged.

Verification: all 12 existing tests in `tests/base` pass against the repo code, plus 13 sanity checks I ran (default encoding, raw passthrough, mimetype guess/cache/None cases, `resolve_image` for both encodings, ChatMessage roundtrips, invalid-encoding rejection). Two pre-existing base-commit quirks I confirmed are unrelated: `ImageBlock(url=None)` validation error and double-encoding when passing pre-built `ImageBlock` instances through `ChatMessage` — both fail identically on the unmodified base commit, so I left them untouched.
